items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: the star of that was Ethel Waters.

ctx.x: So a guy named Speed Webb came to town, to Detroit, and I guess this was still in 1929, late in the year, and he had just made a movie called On With the Show, where he was a bandleader in that, and the star of that was Ethel Waters.
